# A quote in a link address

## The links

A plain link stays a link: [the documentation](https://example.com/docs).

A link address that holds a quote must not end the address early and start an attribute of its own: [a double quote](https://example.com/"onmouseover="alert(1)) and [a single quote](https://example.com/'onfocus='alert(2)).

The attribute need not be a handler to do harm: [a style](https://example.com/"style="position:fixed;inset:0).

An address that holds asterisks must stay one address, with no tag inside it: [the stars](https://example.com/*a*/*b*).
